plain: Belleville Township in New Jersey had a cyber incident. Officials say no ransom was paid. They have not said what was affected, and a former mayor says residents were told little.
summary: Belleville Township, New Jersey, had a cyber incident, The Observer reports. Police Chief Mark Minichini called it "some cyber incident" and said he would not classify it as major; he and the township attorney said no ransom was paid. Mayor Frank Velez III said he could not comment further because the matter is under investigation. Former mayor Michael Melham criticises the delay in acknowledging it.
title: Belleville Township (NJ) officials acknowledge a cyber incident; no ransom paid, they say
